name: Ralo

soc2_evidence.signal: No SOC 2 badge or trust page found; press coverage mentions bank-grade encryption and not storing SSNs in core databases, but no SOC 2 attestation claimed
Operates as licensed mortgage broker in CA/CO/TX handling sensitive borrower financial data (heavily regulated sector)

hiring_signals: Loan Officer Engineer (engineering role, New York, $100K-$150K) - https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/ralo
Performance Marketing Lead and Brand & Social Media Lead also open (3 total jobs on YC page)
pitch_note: Fresh $2.9M seed (June 2026) mortgage broker handling regulated borrower data with a 2-person team, actively hiring engineers, and no SOC 2 attestation found anywhere - lender partnerships and state regulators will force compliance work soon. AWS usage unconfirmed and buyers are consumers rather than enterprises, which is the only soft spot.

name: Eloquent AI

soc2_evidence.signal: Homepage displays AICPA SOC 2 badge linked to Vanta verification
Privacy policy states systems are reviewed against SOC 2 framework at least annually

hiring_signals: AI Engineer, Agent; Forward Deployed Engineer; Software Engineer Front-End; Product Designer (5 open roles)
pitch_note: Already displays a Vanta-verified AICPA SOC 2 badge on its homepage, so the core Type I sale is gone. Only residual angle is Type II expansion or continuous-compliance services as they scale their $7.4M-seeded regulated-financial-services platform.

name: Cotool

Sells AI agents to enterprise security operations teams (customers include Ramp and EliseAI) - buyers who mandate vendor SOC 2

hiring_signals: No open roles listed on YC page (0 jobs); slice data marks is_hiring false
aws_evidence: Subprocessor list names Google Cloud as cloud infrastructure provider; AWS not listed (https://www.cotool.ai/subprocessors)
pitch_note: Sells to enterprise security teams (Ramp, EliseAI) with a fresh a16z-led $7.4M seed and no SOC 2 badge anywhere - security buyers will demand attestation imminently. Docked points because their subprocessor list shows Google Cloud, not AWS, so they miss the AWS-native ICP criterion.

name: Uno Wallet

hiring_signals: No open roles on YC page (0 jobs); slice data marks is_hiring false

name: Saphira AI

soc2_evidence.signal: No SOC 2 certification or trust page found in searches; company sells compliance/safety-certification SaaS to enterprise hardware and robotics manufacturers who run vendor security reviews

hiring_signals: Founding Account Executive - Enterprise Safety & Compliance
pitch_note: Compliance-tooling vendor selling into enterprise industrial/robotics buyers with no SOC 2 of its own, ~$500K pre-seed, and four open founding-engineer/enterprise-AE roles - exactly the profile that needs a fast Type I before enterprise deals close. A compliance company without SOC 2 is also an easy credibility pitch.

name: Unbound

soc2_evidence.signal: Homepage displays 'SOC 2 Compliant' badge and states 'SOC 2 compliant. Available on AWS Marketplace.'

hiring_signals: Slice data marks is_hiring true, but no security/GRC-specific roles verified
aws_evidence: Sells via AWS Marketplace, stated on homepage (https://getunbound.ai/)
pitch_note: Disqualified for the Type I pitch: advertises SOC 2 compliance directly on its homepage and already sells through AWS Marketplace. Only possible angle is ongoing audit/Type II renewal support.
